title: EU Sustainability Reports - Company Record (v0.5 schema)
description: Company-centric record with a multi-entry sustainability_sources array. Replaces the v0.1-v0.4 flat one-entry-per-company shape (see MIGRATION_NOTES.md). A single company may have several source entries over time and across types: a current downloadable_report, an agr_section (sustainability statement embedded in an Annual General Report), and/or a webpage entry, plus older is_legacy:true entries for historical tracking.

company_id.description: Stable, URL-safe slug uniquely identifying the company across the dataset. Generated from company_name at migration time (lowercase, ASCII, hyphen-separated); does not change even if company_name is later corrected/renamed, to avoid breaking entry_id references and external citations.

country.description: HQ country. One of the 27 EU member states in the current pilot scope.

sustainability_sources.description: One or more source entries for this company. Order is not meaningful for consumers; sort by publication_date/reporting_year if a specific order is needed. At least one entry is required per company.

entry_id.description: Stable id for this specific entry, unique within the company. Convention: '<company_id>-<zero-padded sequence>', e.g. 'sap-001'. Never reused, even if an entry is superseded - superseded entries are kept and marked is_legacy:true rather than deleted, so entry_id remains a stable citation target.

source_type.description: Determines which field group below is populated. See per-type rules in the 'Field groups by source_type' section of MIGRATION_NOTES.md / CONTRIBUTING.md.

reporting_year.description: The fiscal/reporting year the source covers, e.g. '2024' or 'FY2024/25'. Free-text string (not integer) to accommodate split fiscal years. Null if not yet determined.

publication_date.description: Date the source document/page was published, if known.

report_url.description: Populated when source_type = downloadable_report: direct link to the downloadable PDF/document. Null for webpage and agr_section entries.

report_title.description: Populated when source_type = downloadable_report: the report's title as published. Null for webpage and agr_section entries.

source_url.description: Populated when source_type = webpage: the live URL of the sustainability page. Null for downloadable_report and agr_section entries.

retrieved_date.description: Populated when source_type = webpage (recommended also for agr_section): the date this entry's contents/URL were last checked, since webpages can change or move without notice. Null for downloadable_report entries.

archive_url.description: Populated when source_type = webpage: a Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) snapshot URL captured at/near retrieved_date, so the citation survives even if the live page changes or disappears. Null for downloadable_report and agr_section entries. See tools/archive_snapshot.py to (re)generate.

parent_document_type.description: Populated when source_type = agr_section: the type of the containing document. Currently only 'annual_general_report' is a defined value; extend the enum here if other embedding-document types are added later. Null for downloadable_report and webpage entries.

parent_document_url.description: Populated when source_type = agr_section: link to the full containing document (e.g. the Annual Report PDF). Null for downloadable_report and webpage entries.

section_reference.description: Populated when source_type = agr_section: where within parent_document_url the sustainability content lives, e.g. a page range ('pp. 45-78') or section name ('Sustainability Statement', 'Non-Financial Information Statement'). Null for downloadable_report and webpage entries.

frameworks_referenced.description: Flat list of reporting frameworks this entry references or is aligned with. Not nested/subfoldered per framework. Empty array if not yet determined - absence of a framework here is not a negative claim, just 'not yet confirmed'.

is_legacy.description: true marks an older/historical entry retained for progress tracking (e.g. last year's report, once a newer one is added). false marks the current/most-recently-confirmed entry for that source_type. A company can have multiple is_legacy:true entries but should generally have exactly one non-legacy entry per source_type at a time (not schema-enforced; see validate_submission.py business-rule checks).

notes.description: Free text: CSRD/ESRS migration notes, name-collision warnings, fiscal-year mismatches, sourcing caveats, etc.
